nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $d$ be natural numbers, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the index set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}^d$, let $k$ be an index and let $i < d$. The shift along axis $i$ determined by $\sigma$ and $k$ is the point $(\sigma(k)_i - k_i)/n$ of the circle $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$, that is, the class modulo $1$ of this real number.
nodes.title: Coordinate shift between grid cubes

nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $d$ be natural numbers and let $k = (k_0, \dots, k_{d-1})$ with each $k_i \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$. The grid cube with index $k$ is the set of points $x$ of the torus $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$ such that, for every $i < d$, the coordinate $x_i$ is the class modulo $1$ of some real number $r$ with $k_i/n \le r < (k_i + 1)/n$.
nodes.title: Grid cube in the torus

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number and let $T$ and $S$ be measurable, invertible, volume-preserving transformations of the torus $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$. Let $\rho$ be the distance on $\mathbb{T}^d$ given by the maximum over the coordinates of the distance on the circle $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$ (taken to be $0$ when $d = 0$). nodes.title: Essential-supremum distance between volume-preserving maps

nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $d$ be natural numbers. For an index $k \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}^d$, the grid cube with index $k$ is the set of points of the torus $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$ whose $i$-th coordinate is the class of a real number in $[k_i/n, (k_i + 1)/n)$ for every $i < d$. nodes.title: Cyclic cube exchange

nodes.title: Lax's approximation theorem

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number. A volume-preserving homeomorphism $T$ of the torus $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$ is regarded as a measurable, invertible, volume-preserving transformation of $\mathbb{T}^d$: the same map, with its inverse, viewed as a measurable equivalence.
nodes.title: Toral dynamical systems as volume-preserving transformations

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number. A toral dynamical system on the torus $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$ is a homeomorphism of $\mathbb{T}^d$ that preserves the volume measure.
nodes.title: Toral dynamical system

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, the $d$-dimensional torus is $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$, the product of $d$ copies of the circle $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Torus

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number. A volume-preserving transformation of the torus $\mathbb{T}^d = (\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^d$ is a bijection $T$ of $\mathbb{T}^d$ such that $T$ and $T^{-1}$ are measurable and $T$ preserves the volume measure.
nodes.title: Volume-preserving transformations of the torus

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
